from_text: 79. A method of operating an inflation valve of an inflatable chamber which holds liquid sealant, the inflation valve comprising a poppet having a supply side, a chamber side and a sealing face, a deflectable ring element, a main passage past the sealing face which is closed by the sealing face in a closed state of the inflation valve, and a return spring biasing the poppet towards the closed state, the method comprising, within one inflation event: coupling an inflation device to the supply side and raising a pressure differential between the supply side and the chamber side to at or above a crack pressure, whereby the poppet moves through a normal stroke into a normal-open state in which inflation gas flows through the main passage into the inflatable chamber while the deflectable ring element remains in its at-rest form and a purge gap associated with the deflectable ring element remains closed; raising the pressure differential above an over-travel threshold higher than the crack pressure, whereby the poppet moves into over-travel beyond the normal stroke and produces a radial deflection of the deflectable ring element, the radial deflection opening the purge gap, and inflation gas flows as an air purge along a purge flow path, separate from the main passage, from the supply side through the purge gap into the inflatable chamber across surfaces on which sealant film accumulates; and removing the inflation device from the supply side, whereby the pressure differential falls and the deflectable ring element undergoes shape recovery to its at-rest form and closes the purge gap.
to: 79. A method of operating an inflation valve of an inflatable chamber which holds liquid sealant, the inflation valve comprising a poppet (40) having a supply side, a chamber side and a sealing face (42), a deflectable ring element (30), a main passage (64) past the sealing face (42) which is closed by the sealing face (42) in a closed state of the inflation valve, and a return spring (50) biasing the poppet (40) towards the closed state, the method comprising, within one inflation event: coupling an inflation device to the supply side and raising a pressure differential between the supply side and the chamber side to at or above a crack pressure, whereby the poppet (40) moves through a normal stroke into a normal-open state in which inflation gas flows through the main passage (64) into the inflatable chamber while the deflectable ring element (30) remains in its at-rest form and a purge gap (60) associated with the deflectable ring element (30) remains closed; raising the pressure differential above an over-travel threshold higher than the crack pressure, whereby the poppet (40) moves into over-travel beyond the normal stroke and produces a radial deflection of the deflectable ring element (30), the radial deflection opening the purge gap (60), and inflation gas flows as an air purge along a purge flow path (62), separate from the main passage (64), from the supply side through the purge gap (60) into the inflatable chamber across surfaces on which sealant film accumulates; and removing the inflation device from the supply side, whereby the pressure differential falls and the deflectable ring element (30) undergoes shape recovery to its at-rest form and closes the purge gap (60).
